source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The customization filter test registers autocomplete before typing and before Escape, then checks child visibility. The availability test iterates customizableItemDetails, selects each pane and checks the correct generic or space-specific palette or target. It explicitly skips global search because that feature is disabled in the test. This is a catalog-driven availability check, not proof that the skipped item works or that palette navigation after filtering is accessible. Preserve the test’s feature-gate limitation.
title: Test palette filtering and item availability against their actual sources
